# Lessa: the President Is "Open"

Senator Augusta Lessa left the palace yesterday saying that President Vento is "open" to rebalancing the Senate by population — a word the Senator repeated four times to reporters in the space of a minute, so that nobody could misquote it. The Ledger has long supported the reform. It notes that the President's own deputies from Mognagna and Ibira are likely to oppose it.
